# nomatron_user (Resource)

Nomatron user resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_user" "example" {
  username    = "tf-test-user"
  name        = "Terraform Test User"
  password_wo = "ChangeMe123!"

  metadata = {
    team  = "platform"
    owner = "terraform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `name` (String) Display name for the user.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Initial password for the user.
- `username` (String) Username for the user.

### Optional

- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the user.

### Read-Only

- `auth_provider` (String) Authentication provider for the user.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the user was created.
- `created_by` (String) Actor that created the user.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active.
